mapper.sql: services.id AS id, services.sku AS sku, services.name AS `name`, services.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, services.section_id AS sectionId, sections.name AS sectionName, services.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, services.unit_price AS unitPrice, services.description AS description, services.chart_account_id AS chartAccountId, CONCAT_WS(' - ', chart_accounts.account_codes, chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName, services.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, services.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM services INNER JOIN companies ON companies.id = services.company_id INNER JOIN sections ON sections.id = services.section_id INNER JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = services.uom_id LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = services.chart_account_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON services.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON services.modified_by = modifier.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO services ( `name`, sku, company_id, section_id, chart_account_id, uom_id, unit_price, description, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{service.name}, #{service.sku}, #{service.companyId}, #{service.sectionId}, #{service.chartAccountId}, #{service.uomId}, #{service.unitPrice}, #{service.description}, NOW(), #{service.createdBy}, #{service.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE services SET `name` = #{service.name}, sku = #{service.sku}, company_id = #{service.companyId}, section_id = #{service.sectionId}, chart_account_id = #{service.chartAccountId}, uom_id = #{service.uomId}, unit_price = #{service.unitPrice}, description = #{service.description}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{service.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{service.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE services SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
